name: Le Meridien Hamburg
positioning: Art-filled design hotel on the banks of the Outer Alster Lake in Hamburg's St. Georg district
best_for: Travelers who want Alster Lake views and suites with a view
Art lovers who want complimentary Deichtorhallen admission
Active guests who want to jog, sail or cycle around the Alster

facts.text: The hotel sits on the banks of the Outer Alster Lake in the St. Georg district.
The hotel is within easy reach of the main station, the harbor and the UNESCO World Heritage sites Speicherstadt and Kontorhausviertel.
Rooms use warm colors and a maritime design.
Bathrooms have a separate shower and a Victorian-style bathtub.
Rooms have Malin + Goetz toiletries, bathrobes and slippers.
The Panorama Lake Suite is spread over two levels with sweeping Alster views.
Lake Suites can be expanded with additional rooms to sleep up to six guests.
Le SPA is inspired by European spa traditions, and Institute SK offers SHAZAY Hairspa rituals there.
The fitness center is open 24 hours a day.
HERITAGE restaurant serves classic cuisine reimagined with modern touches and subtle Asian accents.
The Käpt'n Prüsse sailing school is located opposite the hotel, and bicycle rental is complimentary.
Dogs staying at the hotel receive their own dog bed and food bowls.

highlights.text: The hotel has long been known as an art hotel, with art reflected throughout the building.
The Prestige Lake Suite has panoramic views over the Alster Lake.
Le SPA has a pool, sauna and steam bath.
Guests get complimentary admission to the Deichtorhallen contemporary art museum through Unlock Art.
The two-storey HERITAGE rooftop bar has an outdoor terrace with views over the Alster Lake and the city center.

considerations.text: Cash payment is not possible anywhere in the hotel; major credit cards are accepted.
The hotel looks over the Alster Lake rather than the harbor; the harbor and Speicherstadt are within easy reach.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
